import novamind_api as nm

D0, D1 = 323, 329
print("=== BASE / SUBS ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, effective_price, billing_day_mod30, start_day, status FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'")
print("active subs:", len(r['rows']))
for row in r['rows']:
    print(" ", row)

print("\n=== CANCELS d323-329 (billing-boundary check) ===")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT plan, effective_price, start_day, end_day, status, (end_day-start_day) AS tenure FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('cancelled','lost') AND end_day>={D0} AND end_day<={D1}")
print("cancels this wk:", len(r['rows']))
for row in r['rows']:
    t = row['tenure']
    print(f"  tenure={t} mod30={t%30 if t is not None else 'NA'} {'BILLING-BDY' if (t is not None and t%30==0) else '*** MID-CYCLE ***'} {row}")

print("\n=== LEDGER net d323-329 by category ===")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ledger WHERE day>={D0} AND day<={D1} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
net=0
for row in r['rows']:
    net += row['amt']
    print(f"  {row['category']:28s} {row['amt']:12.2f}  (n={row['n']})")
print(f"  {'NET':28s} {net:12.2f}")

print("\n=== SUB-PAYMENT count this wk ===")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day>={D0} AND day<={D1}")
print("  ", r['rows'])

print("\n=== SERVICE (outage/usage) d323-329 ===")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT service_day, total_usage_units, capacity_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes FROM service_day WHERE service_day>={D0} AND service_day<={D1} ORDER BY service_day")
for row in r['rows']:
    print("  ", row)

print("\n=== ENTERPRISE open threads ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print("  open threads:", r['rows'])

print("\n=== CASH (ledger cumulative) ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS net FROM ledger")
print("  cumulative net:", r['rows'])

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== SERVICE d323-329 (correct cols) ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT day, total_usage_units, capacity_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes FROM service_day WHERE day>=323 AND day<=329 ORDER BY day")
for row in r['rows']:
    print("  ", row)

print("\n=== ENTERPRISE threads ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_threads FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print("  ", r['rows'])

print("\n=== SOCIAL posts d323-329 (viral check) ===")
res = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=50)
posts = res['posts'] if isinstance(res, dict) else res
print("  total posts:", len(posts))
for p in posts[:15]:
    vir = p.get('virality') or p.get('reach') or p.get('viral_score') or '?'
    print(f"  [{p.get('post_day','?')}] grp={p.get('group_id','?')} vir={vir} :: {str(p.get('content',''))[:90]}")

print("\n=== CASH cumulative ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS net FROM ledger")
print("  ", r['rows'])

print("\n=== S2-A next bill projection ===")
# S2-A: start_day 68, bmod 8 -> bills day%30==8 -> next d338, tenure=338-68=270, 270%30==0 billing-boundary
print("  S2-A bills next d338 (tenure 270, %30==0 => billing-boundary => ~96% churn). base 1->0 expected ~d338.")
